from pathlib import Path
program_dir=Path('/home/ubuntu/continual-arc-baselines/.workbench/runs/adhoc-primeagentlearner-1790689809/attempts/82cd395e7c604aefb1723d109802e08f/system/state/workspace/programs')
program_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
path=program_dir/'task-b13b7317.py'
source='''from collections import Counter\n\ndef transform(grid):\n    out = [row[:] for row in grid]\n    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])\n    background = Counter(v for row in grid for v in row).most_common(1)[0][0]\n    marked = set()\n    for r, row in enumerate(grid):\n        if row and row[0] != background and all(v == row[0] for v in row):\n            marked.update((r, c) for c in range(w))\n    for c in range(w):\n        color = grid[0][c]\n        if color != background and all(grid[r][c] == color for r in range(h)):\n            marked.update((r, c) for r in range(h))\n    for r, c in marked:\n        out[r][c] = 2\n    return out\n'''
